desc: The Multiplayer pages left with Escape on the keyboard (Aurora, no window), from the title's page (TTYD_OPEN_MULTIPLAYER): Online... opened, its code keyboard (Join by code) opened, Escape until the keyboard is gone, Escape from Online... to the front list, Escape to the tabs and Escape again closes the pages (the title's buttons). Each Escape must leave the page it is on ('[online] page:' says where it went)
log_must: ^\[title\] the pages closed: back to the title's buttons
